cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Your Turn
cards.instruction: Get someone to accept responsibility for a task you believe should never have been yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You ticked the bathroom box so confidently that I've ticked it too. That records your turn; this was never my job.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A tick means done. Neither of us has cleaned it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, completion. Take the mop and make it match the tick; your name was beside bathroom duty before I got here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you at least show me the right way?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. You hold the mop while I read the instructions on the bottle. Start with the floor by the door.
